units: fractions of area-weighted dry land; positive changes only
rationale: Numerical resolution differences are below 0.05 percentage points. The larger explicit release margins allow local physical corrections, not numerical error: one percentage point per seed for desert/savanna and half a point in the ensemble. Steppe also includes newly viable cold growing seasons and has a separate, reported allowance. These limits are diagnostic only and must not be relaxed after a candidate fails.
